name: Krokočín (Czechia)
description: Three vertical stripes of white, blue and white in the ratio 1:1:1, with a yellow wheat ear in the blue.
history: Granted by decision of the Chairman of the Chamber of Deputies of the Czech Parliament on 14 January 2000 and entered in the Register of Municipal Symbols (REKOS); the flag repeats the colours and charges of the municipal arms.
